launcher.title: Devers Launcher
launcher.subtitle: Modern game launcher for .dvp archives
launcher.desc: A clean, modern launcher for .dvp games created with Devers Packer. Extracts each game into a temp folder, runs it, and cleans everything up when you close it — no leftover files on your disk.
packer.title: Devers Packer
packer.subtitle: Pack any game folder into a single .dvp archive
packer.desc: Turns any game folder into a single .dvp archive — ZIP-based, maximum compression, with an embedded manifest and a cover. The cover editor lets you crop and scale any image to 240×175 with a live preview.
about.title: About Studio
about.subtitle: Made by One — small, focused, open
about.desc: Made by One is a small studio building clean, minimal tools for gamers and developers. Everything we ship is designed to feel light, private, and honest — no telemetry, no bloated installers, no hidden services running in the background.
